BETA Close X RS Group plc has announced the purchase of 299,208 of its ordinary shares for cancellation between July 13th and July 17th, 2026, as part of its £100 million share repurchase program. The average price paid per share during this period was approximately 635.5 pence. This brings the total number of shares repurchased under the program to 3,032,468, leaving 471,017,000 ordinary shares in issue and reducing the total voting rights accordingly. Disclaimer* RS Group PLC 20 July 2026 RS Group plc 20 July 2026 Transaction in Own Shares RS Group plc (the "Company") announces that in the week 13 July 2026 to 17 July 2026, it purchased for cancellation the following number of its ordinary shares of 10 pence each (Ordinary Shares) through Barclays Bank plc, as part of its £100 million share repurchase programme announced on 20 May 2026 (the "Programme"). All Ordinary Shares were purchased from Barclays Bank plc as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange. Date of purchase Number of Ordinary Shares purchased Highest price paid per share (pence per share) Lowest price paid per share (pence per share) Volume weighted average price paid per share (pence per share) Venue 13/07/2026 102,215 630.0000 613.0000 624.5298 LSE 14/07/2026 97,392 644.0000 627.0000 637.5038 LSE 15/07/2026 96,601 650.0000 638.0000 645.7541 LSE Since the commencement of this Programme, the Company has purchased 3,032,468 Ordinary Shares in aggregate for cancellation from Barclays Bank plc in accordance with the Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of these Ordinary Shares, the Company will have 471,017,000 Ordinary Shares in issue, with no shares held in treasury. Therefore, the total number of voting rights in the Company is 471,017,000. This announcement is made in accordance with the requirements of UK Listing Rule 9.6.6. In accordance with Article 5(1)(b) of the Market Abuse Regulation, a breakdown of the individual trades made by Barclays as principal on behalf of the Company in connection with the above purchases is set out below. Purchases made under the Programme will be announced on a weekly basis.
